page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Decorated woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph. Running head at the top with the page number at the top left. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: CUm[?] singularis viri, & propè
diuini, Pauli Florenii tempus a-
desset, quo ex perversa Jesuita-
rum societate ad communem
hominum societatem remigra-
ret: nosq; illo ipso tempore soli essemus, tum
ille, Videtur mihi, inquit, Christiano, rem o-
mnem sincerius & subtilius contemplanti, no-
stra hæc, in qua versamur, religio Jesuitica to-
ta ex superstitione, hypocrisi & ficta quadam
pietaq; sanctitate conflata, ultimaq; hac mun-
di senectute à diabolo excitata: quæ omnes er-
rores, nugas & superstitiones, quæ, uno ut ver-
bo dicam, minus honesto quidem, & quo sanè
inuitus utor, sed huic rei aptissimo, planeq; ne-
cessario, quæ inquam omnia turpissima Papæ
stercora tum graviter per se olentia, tum uero
hoc tempore, quo à curiosis plerisq; & eruditis
viris crebrò commouentur, multò magis fœte-
tia, sanctitatis iam quadam simulatione cŏdita,
temperatáue, meandrisq; nescio quibus, inuo-
luta, orbi Christiano iterum venderet pro aro-
matis, atq; adeò per vim fermè quandam ob-
truderet: ut nihil tam turpe, fœcundum &
falsum in Romana Ecclesia cernatur, quod hæc
nouo non artificio, vel mentis aciem præstrin-
gendo, vel omnem turpitudinem & falsitatem
callidè tegendo, pulchrum apparere faceret,
atq; verum. Quare considerandum nobis etiä

page.notes: The woodcut initial is decorative; the letter is read as C (CUm) with [?]. A small mark after "Christiano" (possibly a reference or asterisk) is unclear and was not transcribed. The catchword "senuntur," at the bottom right is partly unclear and is marked [?]. Spelling "Jesuitica" and "deffet" are as printed, with long s and u/v adjusted per the rules. The last word of the paragraph is taken as "versentur," the catchword is read as its continuation.
